props.title: MESCO At Glance
props.description: MESCO is a Secular Trust registered in 1968 with the Charity Commissioner of Mumbai. The organization is a selfless effort for serving mankind which began with a few friends who constituted the first Managing Committee.

animationsTextParagraphs.text: MESCO is a Secular Trust registered in 1968 with the Charity Commissioner of Mumbai. The organization is a selfless effort for serving mankind which began with a few friends who constituted the first Managing Committee. 'Education' was identified as a core theme for human development by the organization and later it expanded to provide Medical Assistance and Poverty Relief. The organization touches the lives of over 15,000 families annually through a combination of well strategized and implemented schemes, programs, activities and its institutions. The approach has always been to uphold ethical values in delivering and becoming a channel to deliver resources from those who want to give to those who need it the most. Trusted today by a large number of noble souls (individuals, families, foundations, charities and corporate) both in the country and abroad, the organization strives to bring happiness in lives of many.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. NIYAZ AHMED NAKHWA
committeeMembersItems.title: Senior Executive
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mr. Niyaz Ahmed Nakhwa joined MESCO in March 1990 and has worked for more than 26 years in the organization. He presently works as Senior Executive (part of the Fundraising Team). His actions define him as a person who optimizes all his time to promote MESCO. A Science Graduate by Education he worked as a Banking Official for 18 months before joining MESCO.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. FAIZ TANKI
committeeMembersItems.title: Administrative Officer
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mr. Faiz Tanki joined MESCO in 2024 as an administrative officer. He is a professional with a commerce degree and over 25 years of extensive experience in administration and accounts. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated a strong commitment to organizational efficiency and financial accuracy, experienced in overseeing daily operations, streamlining processes, and implementing systems that enhance productivity.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. ZAHID SHAIKH
committeeMembersItems.title: H.O.D - Education
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mr. Zahid Shaikh joined MESCO in July 2003 as Programme Assistant in the Education Dept. In the year 2011, he moved as Head of MESCO Education Society’s Vocational Training Centre. Again, re-joining MESCO in the year 2016, he briefly was in the Medical Department before being appointed as the Head of Education Department. He is a Commerce Graduate from Mumbai University. He has done MBA in Social Entrepreneurship from NMIMS. He has 20 years of vast experience in the Social Development Sector.

committeeMembersItems.name: MS. SADAF KHAN
committeeMembersItems.title: Program Executive - Medical
committeeMembersItems.bio: Ms. Sadaf Khan joined MESCO in December, 2012 as an Admin. Assistant of the Clinics Dept. In 2016 she moved to the Medical Aid Department as a Program Assistant. Currently she manages the said department of MESCO. She is a Science Graduate from the Mumbai University.

committeeMembersItems.name: DR. MOAZZAM MOMIN
committeeMembersItems.title: Manager - Clinics
committeeMembersItems.bio: Dr. Moazzam has over 14 years of health management experience. Prior to joining MESCO in 2014, he served in senior leadership roles at various healthcare facilities. He provides strategic vision, planning and operational leadership. He has experience leading regulated healthcare operations.Dr. Moazzam holds a medical degree and a master's degree in healthcare management.

committeeMembersItems.name: DR. YASMEEN USMANI
committeeMembersItems.title: Co-ordinator - R.C. Mahim Municipal Urdu School
committeeMembersItems.bio: Dr. Yasmeen Usmani is a Ph.D. (Urdu), M. Phil., B. Ed. from Mumbai University. She has done her M.A. in Urdu and B.A. in Urdu and History from Purvanchal University, Jaunpur. She joined MESCO in 2009 as the Co-ordinator for R.C. Mahim Municipal Urdu School, adopted by MESCO. She also teaches in the D. Ed. college of R.C Mahim School.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. ALI HAMZA DALVI
committeeMembersItems.title: Public Relation Officer
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mr. Ali Hamza Dalvi has been an integral part of MESCO since May 1989, dedicating 35 years of exemplary service. For 32 years, he led the Accounts Department as H.O.D. with unwavering discipline and commitment. He then served as an Administrative Officer for two years, contributing to the organization's operational efficiency. Currently, he continues to serve MESCO as a Public Relations Officer, upholding the institution's values and mission.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. MOHAMMED FAIZAN ANSARI
committeeMembersItems.title: H.O.D - C.S.R. & FUND RAISING DEPARTMENT
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mohammed Faizan leads the CSR & Fundraising Department at MESCO, bringing a decade of expertise in revenue growth, lead generation, and sales management within India's top e-commerce sector. Holding an MBA in Marketing along with qualifications in BCA, B.Ed, and D.Ed, he combines strategic business acumen with a strong commitment to social impact, driving initiatives that foster sustainable growth and community development.

donorTestimonialsItems.quote: MESCO is one such catalyst from the cluster of organizations working in development sector in Mumbai for last 50 years with an objective of working for the social upliftment of the backward section of the society. The education schemes devised by the organization are in such a manner which focuses majorly on providing education to girl child right from pre-schooling years till they complete their higher education. MESCO has given wings to girl students so that they can fly in their careers with beautiful colours.
donorTestimonialsItems.name: Ravinder S. Lohia

donorTestimonialsItems.quote: It’s almost 3 decades that I came to know about the good work MESCO was doing. I was impressed about their sincerity, transparency and passion. I suggested them to convert the gifts scholarships into a loan scholarship so that the money could be re-generated especially for the professional scholarship scheme. They were little skeptical about the repayment, however they took it up and today I am happy to know that almost 98% of the amount given out is coming back. I pray that Allah accepts their efforts and bless them.

animationsTextParagraphs.text: Health consciousness is limited only to the privileged ones in society, who have extravagant facilities at their disposal. But there are people in this world for whom, basic healthcare is a distant dream. In the absence of support for health care & treatment, people are pushed towards poverty, permanent disabilities, and dependence at times leading to loss of lives. We at MESCO believe that everyone has the right to access medical support without suffering hardships.

MESCO Medical services aims to provide the best possible aid to all those who are financially challenged and struggling with their medical needs since 1976. Our aid ranges from Medical requirements like routine investigation, MRI, monthly medicines for Chronic Ailments, Minor surgeries to Major surgeries, long-term treatment, Dialysis, etc. MESCO facilitates the Act of Kindness in helping patients lead towards recovery and aims to continue our efforts. This is possible only with the help of our benevolent donors in putting the patients' lives at ease. MESCO provides Medical Aid to patients through the following schemes.

props.titleParagraphContent:
It is through our decades of observation that the government in spite of having substantial public health infrastructure has its own set of limitations in catering to the diverse medical needs of Mumbai's population. The addition of the migrant population coming to Mumbai in the surge for health care support brings in additional challenges.

MESCO's medical services have been working with various government hospitals such as L.T.M.G. Hospital, K.E.M. Hospital, B.Y.L. Nair Hospital, J.J. Hospital, G.T. Hospital, St. George Hospital, Bhabha Hospital, and Shatabdi Hospital since 1976. With the help of its donors, MESCO provides financial assistance to poor patients for their surgeries and treatments at government hospitals.

Life Saving Medical Aid scheme provides financial aid to poor and deserving patients suffering from various medical and surgical conditions for their expensive treatments. This scheme caters to the patients from Pan India who are being treated in Mumbai at Municipal and State Govt. hospitals for pre-planned surgeries and treatments.

Patients suffering from cardiac-related ailments, cancer, cochlear implants, orthopedic issues, hormone deficiency, hepatitis, aplastic anemia, Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS), ITP, immunodeficiency diseases, and various other chronic ailments are helped through this scheme.

accordionItems.label: Medical Services
accordionItems.content:
Health consciousness is limited only to the privileged ones in society, who have extravagant facilities at their disposal. But there are people in this world for whom, basic healthcare is a distant dream. In the absence of support for health care & treatment, people are pushed towards poverty, permanent disabilities, and dependence at times leading to loss of lives. We at MESCO believe that everyone has the right to access medical support without suffering hardships.

MESCO Medical services aims to provide the best possible aid to all those who are financially challenged and struggling with their medical needs since 1976. Our aid ranges from Medical requirements like routine investigation, MRI, monthly medicines for Chronic Ailments, Minor surgeries to Major surgeries, long-term treatment, Dialysis, etc. MESCO facilitates the Act of Kindness in helping patients lead towards recovery and aims to continue our efforts. This is possible only with the help of our benevolent donors in putting the patients' lives at ease. MESCO provides Medical Aid to patients through the following schemes.

accordionItems.label: Life Saving Medical Aid (LSMA)
accordionItems.content:
It is through our decades of observation that the government in spite of having substantial public health infrastructure has its own set of limitations in catering to the diverse medical needs of Mumbai’s population. The addition of the migrant population coming to Mumbai in the surge for health care support brings in additional challenges.

MESCO’s Medical services has been working with various government hospitals such as L.T.M.G. Hospital, K.E.M. Hospital, B.Y.L. Nair Hospital, J.J Hospital, G.T Hospital, St. George Hospital, Bhabha Hospital, Shatabdi Hospital since 1976. With the help of its donors MESCO provides financial assistance to the poor patients for their surgeries and treatments at Govt. hospitals.

Life Saving Medical Aid scheme provides financial Aid to poor and deserving patients suffering from various medical and surgical conditions for their expensive treatments. This scheme caters to the patients from Pan India who are being treated in Mumbai at Municipal and State Govt. hospitals for pre-planned surgeries and treatments.

Patients suffering from Cardiac related ailments, Cancer, Cochlear implants, Orthopedic issues, Hormone deficiency, Hepatitis, Aplastic Anemia, Gullian Barre syndrome (GBS), ITP, Immunodeficiency diseases, and various other chronic ailments are helped through this scheme.

accordionItems.label: Dialysis Support Scheme
accordionItems.content:
Kidney Failure patients or patients with End Stage Renal Disease undergo hemodialysis, which is a procedure to remove waste products and excess fluid from the blood when the kidneys stop working. This process for many such patients is 3 to 4 times a week, extending to 12 times every month. Poor living conditions and risks associated call urgent attention to such needy families. Due to lack of affordability, patients “undertreat” themselves - (Instead opt for less no. of dialysis example 2 instead of 4) which exposes them to higher risks of morbidity. It is extremely disheartening to see kids and young teens who are undergoing dialysis treatment running from pillar to post for collecting funds for treatment, instead of attending schools or colleges during adolescence. To overcome such difficulties MESCO provides financial aid for Dialysis treatment through this scheme.The scheme provides financial assistance for covering the Dialysis cost of patients suffering from Chronic Renal Failure and helps them to live a healthy life.

The scheme is further divided into two distinct components.

Six Months Dialysis Support Scheme:

Renal failure patients undergoing Dialysis are provided financial assistance for their Six months dialysis cost. Patients are selected on the basis of a lottery. To maintain transparency, lots are drawn in front of the applicants and selected beneficiaries are supported for their Six months dialysis expenses.

Sustained Dialysis Support (SDS):

The organization provides financial assistance for Dialysis under the Sustained Dialysis Support Scheme to deserving patients. These were selected from those who were under 6 month’s dialysis support. The scheme was started in the year 2012-13, where lifetime Dialysis Support is being provided to highly deserving cases for Dialysis and Injection costs. There are few patients supported with the lifetime Injection Cost for Dialysis. All the cases inducted under the SDS scheme are fully sponsored cases. If a donor is interested in the sponsorship the vacancy is created and a new deserving dialysis patient is inducted under this scheme.

props.description: MESCO is a Secular Trust registered in 1968 with the Charity Commissioner of Mumbai. The organization is a selfless effort for serving mankind which began with a few friends who constituted the first Managing Committee. ‘Education’ was identified as a core theme for human development by the organization and later it expanded to provide Medical Assistance and Poverty Relief. The organization touches the lives of over 15,000 families annually through a combination of well strategized and implemented schemes, programs, activities and its institutions. The approach has always been to uphold ethical values in delivering and becoming a channel to deliver resources from those who want to giveto those who need it the most.
props.secondaryText: Trusted today by a large number of noble souls (individuals, families, foundations, charities and corporate) both in the country and abroad, the organization strives to bring happiness...

storiesSliderItems.quote: “For me, MESCO is a god sent help, they have helped me financially from the very moment I have been a part of the organization. I had lost my father when I was four; my mother had struggled a lot to manage the finance for my studies. I am truly blessed that I had become a part of this organization as it had helped us acquire financial stability and security. Not just financially, the mentors present in MESCO conduct counseling sessions and provide moral support which truly boosts one’s confidence and willing power to achieve more. I remember attending small gatherings during my teenage years in MESCO wherein the mentors would conduct fun learning activities which were in reality, they were the life lessons taught to us about our mental development, peer pressure and communication skills. I was also lucky enough to attend one of the personality development camps arranged by them where I have explored my potential and realized the confidence, I hold in myself. Currently, I am working in Epicenter Technologies Ltd. promoted as a Trainer coach, I have come so far thanks to MESCO’s contribution to my financial and emotional support. I am grateful to be a part of the Education adoption scheme and thankful for all the support. May the power above bless everyone who has supported me throughout my academic years.”
storiesSliderItems.name: Ms. Acharya Priyanka Vasudev

storiesSliderItems.quote: I am grateful to the Almighty for the blessing of being associated with MESCO since 1991. I have very find memories of all the founder members, trustees and staff of MESCO since my college days. I have seen this organisation grow and progress like Phoenix and love to be a part of any innovative activity being introduced by MESCO. The work in the field of education and skills development has increased with leaps and bounds and am fortunate enough to be a part if several activities and programs of this organisation which has a great share in shaping my career as well. I pray to Allah talah to bless this organisation with all the resources and manpower to be able to cater to our society and help the underprivileged and downtrodden members of the community to get equal opportunities in life and boost to their talent through a great organisation like MESCO.
storiesSliderItems.name: Ms. Farogh Mukadam
storiesSliderItems.role: Deputy Collector and Deputy District Election Officer, Mumbai City District

storiesSliderItems.quote: "Congratulations to MESCO for continuing their beautiful work for 50 long years! We at GiveIndia are honoured to have been a part of the journey. Your relentless hard work and compassion have impacted a remarkable number of people in the city of Mumbai.We have had a fruitful relationship with MESCO ever since we started our journey together in 2011. MESCO has always been compliant with all our norms and readily available for any requirement we ask of them. Their work in the healthcare, education and livelihood space continues to transform lives of the underprivileged every day. We wish to continue the journey for the years to come and bring change together."
storiesSliderItems.name: Lakshmanan

storiesSliderItems.quote: "Baby Nirvi is 3 yrs old girl, was suffering from Pre-B Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (type of blood cancer). When the family got to know about her disease it was a nightmare for them. Baby Nirvi required Chemotherapy treatment at Bai Jerabai Wadia Hospital for the children and needed further line of treatment. The cost of treatment was Rs. 3,00,000/- and it was becoming increasingly difficult for the family to manage expenses. They had exhausted their personal savings and help received from relatives was also limited. Nirvi’s father was the sole earning member of the 5 members family living in a rented house with very basic amenities at Mira Road. He was working as a salesman at a garment shop, earning a nominal income of Rs. 10,000/- p.m. With these limited resources it was very difficult for the family to arrange for the funds. Nirvi's father ran from pillar to post for the arrangement of funds. He was guided to MESCO by the hospital. It was a Nirvi's father’s faith that she will live a normal life one day. MESCO helped her and also guided them to approach other trusts for help. Due to timely treatment, today Nirvi is able to live a normal life. The family is very thankful to all the donors for their timely assistance."
storiesSliderItems.name: Baby Nirvi

props.title: Good Governance
props.description: Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry. Lorem Ipsum has been the industry's standard dummy text

accordionItems.label: Board of Trustees
accordionItems.content: The Board of Trustees set the vision and broad guidelines for the organization and ensure good governance in liaison with the Advisory Board and various Committees. The direction and control of the organization is with Board for social relevance, financial sustainability, monitoring and evaluation and overall growth of organization.

accordionItems.label: Managing Committee
accordionItems.content: Members of Managing Committee are dedicated professionals and individuals from diverse backgrounds and experts in social engineering. They are involved in developing, reviewing policies and schemes with an aim to optimize the resources for our beneficiaries. Strategic and Operational matters are also discussed among the members of the committee. It comprises of 08 members. Detailed agenda and proceedings of these meetings are documented for future reference. The Managing Committee formulates the structure of authority and responsibilities and it is delegated to the concerned staff members of the organization.

accordionItems.label: Sub-Committee
accordionItems.content: Members of the sub-committee are present in the monthly meetings and express their point of views and share their experiences regarding matters which are being discussed. They are also part of the regular events and programs. The sub-committee comprises of the 5 members.

accordionItems.label: Advisory Board
accordionItems.content: The Board of Advisors comprises of experienced professionals. Members of this board also meet regularly. They provide necessary professional advice to the executive committee members and are also invited to attend important meetings.

accordionItems.label: Portfolio Committees
accordionItems.content: Mapping the need to keep pace with the changes in the implementation ecosystem, MESCO has evolved a decentralized mechanism in form of a forum to address, shape up and recommend policies that are required to run the schemes (or programs). This forum is termed as the Portfolio Committee. It’s a committee that suggests a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, a committee that chalks out a course or principle of action and recommends them to be ratified and adopted by the Managing Committee, a committee to review the basic indicators (programmatic) in a periodic manner.

accordionItems.label: Department
accordionItems.content: Organization consists of various departments for operational purpose as per the nature of the undertakings and as per the tasks handled. Monthly meetings are held for each and every department for reviewing activities held in the entire month. It ensures the systematic delegation of tasks, activities and responsibilities.
